reason: In lib/file_helper.rb:31, the `images` set includes "svg", so `is_image?` (line 5) returns true for .svg files. The new loop in app/controllers/uploads_controller.rb (patch lines 41-46) therefore calls `OptimizedImage.downsize(tempfile.path, tempfile.path, "80%")` on oversized SVGs, and `downsize_instructions` (app/models/optimized_image.rb:126-134) runs ImageMagick `convert ... -resize`, which writes its output over the uploaded file.
